description: This file defines the API and data structures for computing CRC32C checksums, including functions for calculation, extension, concatenation, and arithmetic operations on CRC values. It also defines the crc32c_t class for representing CRC32C values.

classes.name: crc32c_t
classes.description: A strongly-typed class representing a CRC32C checksum value with comparison operators.

methods.name: ComputeCrc32c
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32C checksum for a given string buffer.

methods.name: ExtendCrc32c
methods.description: Extends an existing CRC32C checksum with additional data.

methods.name: ExtendCrc32cByZeroes
methods.description: Extends a CRC32C checksum by appending zero bytes.

methods.name: MemcpyCrc32c
methods.description: Copies data between buffers and returns the CRC32C checksum of the copied data.

methods.name: ConcatCrc32c
methods.description: Concatenates two CRC32C checksums into one.

methods.name: RemoveCrc32cPrefix
methods.description: Removes a prefix from a CRC32C checksum.

methods.name: RemoveCrc32cSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix from a CRC32C checksum.
